title: Localizing Weil hulls and their ordinary Brown adjoints
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$, with $Y_0$ quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally of finite type over $k_0$, and $X_0$ quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$. Fix its native chosen compactification $X_0\xrightarrow{j_0}Z_0\xrightarrow{p_0}Y_0$, where $j_0$ is open and $p_0$ proper. For $T_0=X_0,Y_0,Z_0$ write $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$, and use the locally finite continuous coefficient sheaf $B_T$, its internal module category $\mathcal A_T$, the geometric Frobenius pullback $P_T$, and the fixed-pair heart $\mathcal W_T=\mathcal A_T^{P_T}$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Thus a constructible sheaf has locally a finite locally closed constructible stratification and, on each stratum, a pro-etale covering with finite free model $B_U^{\oplus r_U}$ on each member $U$; ranks may depend on $U$. Put $\mathcal C_T=D^b_{\mathrm{cons}}(\mathcal A_T)$ and $\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal C_T)$, the full replete triangulated closure under small coproducts in the ordinary derived category. Fix one universe for all Hom groups, generating sets and coproducts [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]. Write $U_T:D(\mathcal W_T)\to D(\mathcal A_T)$ for derived forgetting, $I_T\dashv U_T$ for exact free induction with $U_TI_TA=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}P_T^nA$ [lem-sf-free-derived-weil-resolution], and $\eta_T$ for its unit. Set $F=Rp_*D(j_!)$ and $F_W=Rp_*^{\mathcal W}D(j_!^{\mathcal W})$, the actual native sheaf operations with their specified coefficient maps and Frobenius lifts, on ordinary unbounded derived categories. Neither scheme is required to be separated over $k_0$.

Choose a set $S_T$ of representatives of $\mathcal C_T$, whose essential smallness is part of [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-constructible-realization], and put $\mathcal L_{W,T}=\operatorname{Loc}(I_TS_T)\subset D(\mathcal W_T)$. Then
$$\mathcal L_{W,T}=\{K\in D(\mathcal W_T):U_TK\in\mathcal L_T\}.$$
In particular $I_T\mathcal L_T\subset\mathcal L_{W,T}$, $U_T\mathcal L_{W,T}\subset\mathcal L_T$, and every native bounded constructible Weil complex lies in $\mathcal L_{W,T}$. The restrictions
$$F:\mathcal L_X\longrightarrow\mathcal L_Y,\qquad F_W:\mathcal L_{W,X}\longrightarrow\mathcal L_{W,Y}$$
are triangulated and preserve all small coproducts in the chosen universe. There exist ordinary right adjoints
$$G:\mathcal L_Y\longrightarrow\mathcal L_X,\qquad G_W:\mathcal L_{W,Y}\longrightarrow\mathcal L_{W,X},\qquad F\dashv G,\quad F_W\dashv G_W.$$
For either $L=F$ or $L=F_W$ and every object $M$ of its displayed target, the cohomological functor $H_M(A)=\operatorname{Hom}(LA,M)$ valued in abelian groups takes coproducts to products, has a small weakly universal family of elements (each $z\in H_M(Z)$ pulls back from one element of that family along some map $Z\to B_i$), and is represented by the corresponding right-adjoint value. Both source hulls have split idempotents. No right adjoint on the entire pro-etale derived category, and no compactness of the constructible generators, is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-native-weil-derived-induction-comparison] with exactly the fixed compactification and native coefficient maps of the statement. It supplies Grothendieck hearts, exact conservative coproduct-preserving $U_T$, preservation of $\mathcal C_T$ and $\mathcal L_T$ by $P_T$, triangulated $F,F_W$, and the natural comparison $\beta:U_YF_W\simeq FU_X$. Only these clauses are used, not its additional induction-comparison assertion. The proved K-injective derived-coproduct existence theorem [lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts] supplies the ambient coproducts. For the hull theorem alone apply the native comparison to the identity compactification of T. The missing quasi-separatedness follows since a scheme locally of finite type over a field is locally Noetherian, hence has quasi-separated underlying space. K-injective resolutions exist for both hearts, so derived local smallness puts all their Hom groups in the fixed morphism universe; full subcategories inherit these Hom groups. The hypotheses allow nonseparated schemes, as does the cited native comparison.

proof.text: By [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-constructible-realization], choose the small representative set $S_T$ in the stated universe. Exact free induction preserves coproducts by [lem-sf-free-derived-weil-resolution]. The class of $A\in D(\mathcal A_T)$ with $I_TA\in\operatorname{Loc}(I_TS_T)$ is therefore replete, triangulated and coproduct closed and contains $S_T$; it contains $\mathcal L_T$. Hence $I_T\mathcal L_T\subseteq\mathcal L_{W,T}$. For $S\in S_T$, the formula $U_TI_TS=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}P_T^nS$ lies in $\mathcal L_T$, since every $P_T^n$ preserves $\mathcal C_T$: for $n\ge0$ by step 1. For $n<0$, $P_T=\bar F_T^{*}$ is pullback along the scheme automorphism $\bar F_T$ of $T$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], so $P_T^{-1}\cong(\bar F_T^{-1})^{*}$, again an exact pullback along a scheme automorphism. It carries $B_T$ to $B_T$, because sections of $B_T$ are locally finite continuous functions on underlying spaces, transported by precomposition. It carries a finite partition by locally closed constructible subschemes and a pro-etale covering with models $B_U^{\oplus r_U}$ to their preimages under $\bar F_T$, which are of the same kind. Hence $P_T^{-1}$ and all its powers preserve constructible sheaves and bounded constructible cohomology. Exactness and coproduct preservation of $U_T$ show its inverse image of $\mathcal L_T$ is localizing. It contains $I_TS_T$, and consequently $U_T\mathcal L_{W,T}\subseteq\mathcal L_T$. These are two applications of the defining minimality of a localizing hull. In Lean, representative independence is proved first by the two minimality inequalities and transport of the free images along the representative isomorphisms. The native pullback lemma boundedAdicConstructible_mapDerivedCategory_upperStar applies to either automorphism. The canonical adicUpperStarIsoLowerStarInv and uniqueness of equivalence inverses identify the chosen inverse of the derived Frobenius with the derived pushforward along the inverse automorphism. Induction separately on the positive and negative powers proves constructibility of every integer summand; HeartProperties gives the actual colimit cocone for U I A.

proof.text: For any $K$ with $U_TK\in\mathcal L_T$, step 2 gives $I_TU_TK\in\mathcal L_{W,T}$. The natural cyclic triangle $I_TU_TK\to I_TU_TK\to K\to I_TU_TK[1]$ of [lem-sf-free-derived-weil-resolution] then places $K$ in $\mathcal L_{W,T}$ by closure under distinguished cones. Together with step 2 this proves the displayed equality of hulls. If $K$ is a native bounded constructible Weil complex, exact forgetting identifies the cohomology of $U_TK$ with its underlying constructible cohomology, by the definition [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]; thus $U_TK\in\mathcal C_T\subseteq\mathcal L_T$ and the equality applies. The existing freeWeil_mem_localizingClosure already packages this cyclic-triangle consequence. Minimality and the induction inclusion from step 2 map its generating class into the stated Weil hull. For native bounded Weil complexes, bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj and mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso identify boundedness and each constructible cohomology group after forgetting.

proof.text: The geometric restriction $F:\mathcal L_X\to\mathcal L_Y$ is triangulated and coproduct preserving by [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-sums]. Its finite-type hypotheses hold: the quasi-compact locally finite-type structure morphisms are finite type, and $Z_0$ is finite type because it is proper over $Y_0$; these properties survive extension to $k$. For $K\in\mathcal L_{W,X}$, $U_YF_WK\simeq FU_XK\in\mathcal L_Y$, so step 3 puts $F_WK$ in $\mathcal L_{W,Y}$. For a small family $(K_i)$ there, apply $U_Y$ to its canonical coproduct comparison $\bigoplus_i F_WK_i\to F_W(\bigoplus_iK_i)$. Naturality of $\beta$ identifies its restrictions to the coprojections with $F$ applied to the underlying coprojections, hence identifies it with the coproduct comparison for $F$. This is an isomorphism. Conservativity of $U_Y$ proves the comparison for $F_W$ is an isomorphism, including for the empty family. Its triangulation is inherited from the native ambient functor in step 1. Construct the geometric compactification literally from the geometricFiberMap of j and p, using geometricFiberMap_comp for its factorization and stability under base change for properness. Its geometric structure maps carry explicit finite-type and quasi-compact instances. For the Weil restriction use the natural comparison between the two composites of restrictions and derived forgetting. Forgetting preserves coproducts and reflects isomorphisms, so it reflects these colimits; preservation therefore descends to the Weil compact-support restriction.

proof.text: Both source hulls are full replete triangulated subcategories closed under all small coproducts; their ambient coproducts remain coproducts in the full subcategories. In particular they have countable coproducts. Apply [lem-countable-coproducts-idempotent-complete] to each hull to obtain split idempotents. Its zero, integer-shift and additive-shift hypotheses are inherited from the ordinary derived categories.

proof.text: Let $L$ be either restriction in step 4 and $M$ any object in its target. Define $H_M(A)=\operatorname{Hom}(LA,M)$ and let a morphism act by precomposition with its image under $L$. These are abelian groups in the fixed universe by step 1. Applying $L$ to a distinguished triangle and then [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] gives the exact Hom sequence; rotations and shifts give exactness at every position, so $H_M$ is cohomological. The coproduct universal property and step 4 give the natural additive bijection $H_M(\bigoplus_iA_i)\cong\prod_iH_M(A_i)$, by restriction along the images of the coprojections. The Mathlib Triangulated.Yoneda instance and composition of homological functors implement exactness. The opposite of a coproduct-preserving functor preserves the corresponding products; the additive Yoneda functor preserves limits.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-set-generated-derived-solution-set] first with heart $\mathcal A_X$, generating set $S_X$, hull $\mathcal L_X$, and then with heart $\mathcal W_X$, generating set $I_XS_X$, hull $\mathcal L_{W,X}$. The hearts are Grothendieck by step 1. Both sets are small by step 2 (the image of a small set under a functor is small), and both hulls have exactly the minimality and coproduct closure required in that theorem. Step 6 verifies its cohomological and product hypotheses for each $H_M$. It therefore supplies a small family $(B_i,b_i)$ such that every $z\in H_M(Z)$ equals $H_M(a)(b_i)$ for some $a:Z\to B_i$. This is the asserted solution family without a compactness hypothesis. The realization targetSmall field gives essential smallness of the ordinary generating property by the small-model equivalence. The free generating property is contained in the essential image of the free functor on that full subcategory, so is essentially small as well. The closure minimality hypothesis is exactly localizingClosure_le with the given triangulated, replete and coproduct-closed property.

proof.text: For each $H_M$, apply [lem-sfb-cohomological-solution-set-representability]. The hull is locally small by step 1, pretriangulated with the required coproducts by its definition, and has split idempotents by step 5. Steps 6 and 7 verify the remaining hypotheses.
